catalysts.headline: Micron sold out cutting-edge memory capacity through late 2026; UBS raises HBM pricing-growth estimate to 79% annually; Dell's $95bn AI server backlog cited as proof hyperscalers are buying every available wafer
catalysts.magnitude: UBS HBM pricing-growth revision to 79%/yr; Micron capacity sold out through late-2026 -- independently corroborates the slice's Susquehanna figure's direction, not its magnitude

catalysts.headline: Susquehanna DRAM +50%+/NAND +60% QoQ contract-price claim -- CONFIDENCE DOWNGRADED: HBMTracker G8 flags this as tier-3-sourced and unverified, conflicting with TrendForce's own 4Q26 guide of +3-8% QoQ
catalysts.magnitude: price reaction (MU +6.1%, SNDK +11.9%, SKHY +8.1%) is confirmed; the +50/+60% magnitude driving it is not

catalysts.headline: Nvidia agrees to pay $12.9bn for Hugging Face, driving AI-silicon complex-wide sympathy rally (NVDA, MRVL +6.3%, KLAC +7% per Seeking Alpha, AVGO, COHR record high) with no own-name fundamental change
catalysts.magnitude: $12.9bn deal size; SMH +1.7% intraday 9/5; multiple re-rating, not earnings revision

theme_updates.theme_2_memory_pricing: 9/5 rally corroborated from two angles -- one unverified (Susquehanna), one independently sourced (Micron sold-out capacity/UBS 79%/Dell backlog) -- same direction, only Susquehanna's magnitude is in question
